theory.title: Pronombres reflexivos y by + pronombre reflexivo
theory.explanation: Usa los pronombres reflexivos cuando quien realiza la acción y quien la recibe son la misma persona: I taught myself (aprendí por mí mismo/a). La estructura by + pronombre reflexivo significa «solo/a» o «sin ayuda». También aparece en expresiones habituales como enjoy yourself (divertirse) y help yourself (servirse).
theory.tip: Myself, yourself, himself… cuando sujeto y objeto son la misma persona; by myself = solo/a.

content.passage: When Ana moved abroad, she had to organise many things herself. She introduced herself to her neighbours and learned the local bus routes by herself. At first, she felt nervous, but she soon made friends at a language exchange. The group encouraged everyone to speak confidently and enjoy themselves. After a few months, Ana felt proud of herself because she had become more independent.

items.modelAnswer: I taught myself how to use a basic photo-editing programme by watching online lessons. At first, I could only crop pictures, but now I can adjust light and colour. I enjoy learning at my own speed.

items.prompt: Talk about a time you introduced yourself to new people.
items.modelAnswer: At a language exchange meeting, I introduced myself to a group of people from different countries. I said where I lived and asked what languages they were learning. We soon found several topics to discuss.

items.prompt: Describe an event where you enjoyed yourself.
items.modelAnswer: I really enjoyed a neighbourhood music festival last summer. I helped organise the seating and then watched local bands perform. I felt proud of myself because I had contributed to the event.

items.prompt: Have you ever travelled by yourself? Explain.
items.modelAnswer: Yes, I travelled by myself to Amsterdam for a long weekend. I planned the route, booked the hotel and visited museums alone. It was a little strange at first, but I became more confident each day.

items.prompt: Talk about something you prepared yourself.
items.modelAnswer: I prepared a birthday meal myself for my partner. I chose the recipes, bought the ingredients and decorated the table. It took most of the afternoon, but I was pleased when everyone enjoyed the food.

items.prompt: Explain how to make a visitor feel at home.
items.modelAnswer: To make a visitor feel at home, offer them something to drink and show them where everything is. Ask if they need anything, but don't make them feel they have to accept. A relaxed welcome is the most important thing.

items.prompt: Describe a skill you learned by yourself.
items.modelAnswer: I learned basic guitar chords by myself using video lessons. I practised for fifteen minutes every evening and recorded my progress. I still make mistakes, but I can now play a few songs.

items.prompt: Talk about a time you had to organise something yourselves.
items.modelAnswer: We had to organise the school fair ourselves because the teacher was away. We divided the jobs, made a timetable and asked local shops for donations. Working together made the event successful.

items.prompt: What should people be proud of themselves for?
items.modelAnswer: People should be proud of themselves for trying something difficult, helping others or continuing after a setback. Success is not always a prize; sometimes making progress is an achievement.
I taught myself to cook a new dish. I introduced myself to the other volunteers. We organised the event ourselves. These examples show how reflexive pronouns emphasise the person doing the action.

content.audioTranscript: A: How was the cultural exchange? B: Great. The students stayed with a local host family. A: Did they learn about local traditions? B: Yes, and they practised the language every day. A: Did they attend the town festival? B: They did. The whole community was involved. A: How did the visitors behave? B: They showed respect and made new friendships.
